Specification: This module defines structural predicates and set constructors for directed and undirected graphs, along with path-based connectivity and a rooted tree predicate. It models graphs as records with fields `node` and `edge`, where edges are pairs of nodes, and uses sequence-valued paths to express reachability and strong connectivity. The specification is not a transition system and contains no state variables, actions, or temporal properties; instead it provides static mathematical definitions for graph classes, subgraphs, paths, connectivity, and rooted trees.
SetEnumeration:
{H \in [node : SUBSET G.node, edge : SUBSET (G.node \X G.node)] :
     IsDirectedGraph(H) /\ H.edge \subseteq G.edge}
